llm_response.reason: The domain was registered in July 2025, yet the site claims over 10 years in business and thousands of customers. Content guarantees unrealistic high returns (up to 80%) and uses psychological tactics (instant withdrawals, 'experts' working for you, awards, vague testimonials), but provides no verifiable company registration, business contacts, or evidence of legitimacy. Payment methods are unusual and focused on crypto. All these align closely with common characteristics of investment scam websites.
